text:
leah: quick heads-up — seeing a recurring OOM on kv-shard-prod-7 over the last 3 deploys, looks like residency creeping after ~18h, similar to last month's postmortem :frowning_face: https://pm.internal/redwood/postmortems/2026-03-kv-oom

sahil: thanks. can you paste the top-line alloc profile and the slab stats?

leah: attaching short dump below (trimmed) —
```
# pmap  # pid 1894
 total 1.9G anon 1.2G mapped 600M
 slab-reserve: 320M -> 450M (20% growth)
 kv-residency: 1.1G -> 1.37G over 18h
```

evan: repeating pattern: minor GC stops, then slow climb. maybe a cold-path that pins blocks. i ran a quick sampling profile: `perf top` showed hotspots in `Shard::reserveIfNeeded` and `slab::allocate_slowpath`.

dana: we discussed soft-limits last retro. suggestion: temporary guardrail to avoid full OOM while we root cause. propose soft_limit=1.6G on shard-prod-7 and a circuit to reject heavy writes over 10k/s for 12h.

leah: +1 on guardrail. if ops-bot can push, that buys time. who wants remediation owner for core investigation?

sahil: i can own investigation and initial profiling. timeline: 48h to produce a reproduction and a prioritized list of fixes. will need help from evan for slab internals.

evan: happy to pair. i'll instrument the slowpath with extra allocation tags and add a slab allocation histogram (per-size bucket). sending a PR in the morning.

leah: ok owners: sahil (investigation), evan (instrumentation), dana (ops mitigation + rollout). dana can you coordinate the softlimit canary and rollback plan?

dana: yep. plan: roll soft_limit=1.6G to 5% of shard-prod instances at 10:10 UTC, monitor 30m, expand to 50% if no regressions, full at 2h. rollback trigger: >2x error-rate or latency spike >30p. will document steps in runbook.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: shard-config-bump -> soft_limit=1.6G (canary 5%) at 10:10 UTC by dana. alerts: `kv.residency.delta > 100MB / 1h`, `error.rate > 0.5%`

leah: checklist for sahil: 1) repro on staging (attach workload script) 2) perf recordings at 5m intervals 3) heap diff snapshots 4) validate caching semantics not leaking references.

sahil: starting repro now. workload script: `scripts/repro_kv_residency.sh --concurrency=120 --kv-size=32k --duration=2h` — will share logs.

evan: quick note: also look for coalesced allocations in the backpointer map; we've seen ref cycles manifest similarly before. will add a targeted GC-trigger test.

leah: longer-term remediation candidates (brainstorm): slab compaction on idle, strict per-key residency caps, eager KV eviction for cold prefixes, and a GC sweep for backpointer graph. rank after profiling.

dana: created follow-up doc: https://wiki.internal/redwood/eng/runtime/heap-residency-audit (owners + timeline). assigning weekly rotation for 'residency watch' on-call: week-1 sahil, week-2 evan, week-3 leah.

sahil: will post preliminary profiling artifacts by EOD and ping here. who can review a perf patch? evan?

evan: will review. also adding a probe to emit `slab_fragmentation_pct` metric so we can chart fragmentation vs time.

leah: decision log: temporary softlimit + write-throttle canary (ops), deep profiling & instrumentation (sahil/evan), runbook + owner rotation (dana). aim to close critical fixes in 2 sprints, smaller patches in 1 sprint.

dana: thanks — i'll run the canary and update the follow-up doc with timestamps and links to alerts.

leah: closing note: if pattern recurs after fixes we escalate to infra-wide GC/allocator refactor. for now treat as medium P1 and track in postmortem follow-ups board. :white_check_mark:
